description: Check a workflow draft without saving or running it

parameter.label: Workflow spec
parameter.description: One aotn-workflow/1 JSON object. e/Enter: edit full text.

default.name: Checked spec
default.description: The parsed input spec; only after validation passes

report.name: Check report
report.description: Optional verdict, warnings and counts; no spec body

max_spec.label: Max spec (characters)
max_spec.description: Same verdict as build --check; warnings pass. No workflow is saved. Hard limits: 128 nodes / 256 edges / nesting 64.

fail_on_unreachable.label: Reject unreachable nodes
fail_on_unreachable.description: Treat unreachable-node warnings as a failed check; other warnings still pass.

errors.description: Check spec sources, outputs and limits.
Spec is not valid JSON text.
Workflow spec did not pass; see the problem list.
Spec exceeds a size or graph limit.
